description: This Java class 'TranslationPruner' is a utility for pruning translation JSON files by removing keys not present in a reference locale file. It recursively collects JSON keys, prunes source translation files accordingly, and writes the pruned files to a destination folder.

classes.name: TranslationPruner
classes.description: A utility class for pruning translation JSON files based on a reference locale structure.

methods.name: collectKeys
methods.description: Recursively collects all JSON keys in dot notation from a given JSON node.

methods.name: pruneNode
methods.description: Prunes a JSON ObjectNode, keeping only fields whose dot-keys are in the valid set.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that processes source translation files, prunes them based on a reference file, and writes the output.
